source: physical white SG90 cross horn; photographs in REFERENCES are shape references only; no dimensions inferred from photos
axes: X along long opposing arms; Y along short opposing arms
small_horn_hole_entry: Each record requires diameter_mm, x_center_mm and y_center_mm, measured from the central hub center; X is along the long-arm axis. Omit holes if only the torque-fit pocket is needed.
notes: Measure physical parts with calipers; photos have no scale. Root width is across the arm just outside the center hub; tip width is at the rounded end. Tip radius may be measured directly or supplied in a square-on top photo with a ruler in the same plane. Set pocket clearance as a separate candidate parameter and select only after ABS coupon tests. Horn arms carry torque against pocket walls; original retaining screw provides axial retention only. Small arm-hole pattern does not control torque and may be omitted from the fit coupon.
